name: Test of Lore
summary: At Braug Dimspirit’s perch in Stonetalon, you face a test of ancient history. Having retrieved the tome Legacy of the Aspects, you must show what its lessons taught you. A wrong answer sends you far across Kalimdor.

sections.title: A Trial of Wisdom
sections.body: Braug Dimspirit’s trial follows the tests Dorn Plainstalker began at the Weathered Nook. It calls for understanding, not martial survival or blind trust. Braug lives among the crags of the Stonetalon Mountains. He expects seekers to recover ancient texts and learn from their pages.

sections.title: Legacy of the Aspects
sections.body: The lesson concerns how the Dragon Aspects were created and divided, and the pact they made long before the Great Sundering. Braug asks what the tome says about the Earth Warder, Neltharion. His madness and betrayal reshaped Azeroth’s surface. You must understand this history before continuing along the path of wisdom.

sections.title: The Price of Guesswork
sections.body: Braug Dimspirit sends seekers who answer incorrectly away by mystic means. A wrong answer carries you to Camp Taurajo in the southern Barrens, far from the hermit. To face Braug’s scrutiny again, you must make the long trek back into Stonetalon.

faq.q: What is the answer to Braug Dimspirit's question?
faq.answer: Braug asks you to name the Earth Warder in Legacy of the Aspects. The answer is Neltharion, the Black Aspect who turned against his fellow dragons.

faq.q: What happens if you answer incorrectly?
faq.answer: A wrong answer brings immediate magical banishment to Camp Taurajo in the Barrens. You must travel back to Braug’s perch in the Stonetalon Mountains to try again.
Braug Dimspirit is an elder hermit in the Stonetalon Mountains who tests the Horde’s knowledge and lore. He continues the spiritual trials Dorn Plainstalker began in Thousand Needles.

faq.q: How does this connect to the trials in Thousand Needles?
faq.answer: Dorn Plainstalker began the trials at the Weathered Nook in Thousand Needles with the Test of Faith. After testing physical and spiritual trust, Dorn sends worthy initiates across Kalimdor to elders who test their intellect, resolve, and strength.

faq.q: What book is Braug quizzing you about?
faq.answer: Braug tests your understanding of Legacy of the Aspects, an ancient treatise about the titans blessing the five Great Dragon Aspects to guard Azeroth.

faq.q: Where does this quest chain lead next?
aliases: what is after test of lore
next quest in test of lore
faq.answer: Passing Braug’s test of the Dragon Aspects leads to further investigations into ancient history. Seekers must search distant regions for lost records and ancestral knowledge.

angles.text: As a member of the Horde, you face trials in Kalimdor that demand more than brute force. Warriors and shamans alike are expected to understand the ancient scars and draconic powers that shaped the continent.
As a tauren, you honor ancestral wisdom and ancient history. This trial asks young champions to understand the world’s balance before they march into danger.
As a mage, you may recognize the skill behind Braug’s teleportation ward. Stonetalon’s hermits wield ancient magic to discipline careless scholars.
